title.narrative: Father A Nation: Prevention of Gender-Based Violence and bullying in schools

description.narrative:
Gender based violence (GBV) and bullying are major challenges in South African schools and broader society. The South African president has called GBV our second epidemic and a human rights violation. Interventions to reduce and ultimately eliminate the scourge of gender-based violence are crucial. This project aims to contribute to the goal of reducing gender-based violence in South African communities, in particular teaching children and addressing behaviour at school levels.
Key results: • Reduction of the incidences of bullying and gender-based violence in 45 schools in the Gauteng, Mpumalanga, Free State and Limpopo provinces of South Africa. • Increased awareness and understanding of gender-based violence and bullying among the project participants, within an age range 15 to 20. • Female learners not accepting abusive behaviour in the project schools. • Male learners understanding healthy masculinity and changing their behaviour in the project schools. • Programme to be successfully implemented in 45 schools involving 10,000 plus learners.
